dialogues.editWindowHint:
Portrait

The portrait section of this window contains slots with portraits corresponding to cells with portraits in the Visual Novel window.

The slot being edited is highlighted with an orange border. You can edit the portrait data in the editable slot through this window.

The active slot is highlighted with a black gradient background behind the portrait image. Portraits that are NOT in the active cells will be darkened and minimized.

  • Pressing the left-mouse button on the slot will select the slot as editable

  • Pressing the right-mouse button on the slot will remove portrait from slot/cell

  • Pressing Shift + LMB on the slot will toggle activity of slot/cell

  • Pressing Ctrl + LMB on the slot will make the slot/cell the only active at the corresponding side (left/right)

You can move portraits between cells by moving them between slots. If you move a portrait into an already occupied slot - they swap places. If you move the portrait from the slot to a cell it will be cloned.

Portrait Settings

As mentioned above, you can change the settings of the portrait that is selected in the editable slot. In order to do this, you can use the Change Name and Change Title fields, Scale and Offset sliders, and the checkboxes in the advanced settings section.

Any changes that you make are visible only to you, and will only be applied (and shown to everyone) when you click the "Apply" button at the bottom of this window. The " Cancel" button cancels all the changes you have made. In addition, the Reset button to the right of the Cancel button resets the Scaling and Offsets

discordMenu.guideText1-1: 1. Enable the "Developer Mode" in the Discord settings, in the "Advanced" section, to get the Channel ID and User ID.
discordMenu.guideText1-2: 2. Copy the Channel ID of the voice channel you want to use, right-click on it and select the "Copy Channel ID" option.
discordMenu.guideText1-3: 3. Copy your User ID, right-click on yourself (for example in the voice channel), and select the "Copy User ID" option.
discordMenu.guideText1-4: 4. Add the bot to your Discord server. You can get the full instructions on how to create a bot quickly by clicking on the button below. This will take no more than a few minutes and does not require any special knowledge.
discordMenu.guideText1-5: 5. Specify the bot token in the file token.txt in the folder: ../modules/visual-novel-reverse/bot/token.txt
discordMenu.guideButton: Open instructions for creating a Bot and receiving its token
discordMenu.guideText2-0: IMPORTANT: Make sure you have Node.js installed (see nodejs.org/en/download for information)
discordMenu.guideText2-1: 1. Run the file "start.bat" in the bot folder inside the module folder to start the Discord Bridge (../modules/visual-novel-reverse/bot/start.bat).
discordMenu.guideText2-2: 2. Wait for the message "Logged in as [BOT_USERNAME]" in the opened terminal to make sure the bot is running.
discordMenu.guideText2-3: 3. Click the 'Connect' button in THIS window if the connection did not occur automatically.
discordMenu.guideText2-4: 4. Click the "Add bot to voice channel" button and wait for the bot to join the channel.
discordMenu.guideText2-5: Note: the "Add bot" and "Kick bot" buttons may not work immediately, or may require a few clicks.
discordMenu.notHost: Only the host of the Discord Bridge can start it (setting below)
